name: goa.add
doc: Start GNOME Online Accounts' own add dialog for {provider} (google, ms_graph, exchange, owncloud, imap_smtp, webdav, kerberos) in win11-gtk-settings --goa-add; the account arrives with goa.changed.

name: goa.list
doc: The online accounts of goa-daemon: {available, canAdd, accounts: [{id, provider, providerName, presentationIdentity, attentionNeeded, locked, services: [{id, on}]}]}; event goa.changed.

name: goa.providers
doc: The account providers GNOME Settings offers: {providers: [{type, name}], canAdd}.

name: goa.remove
doc: Remove the online account {id} (Account.Remove); not for an account the organisation manages.

name: goa.setService
doc: Use the online account {id} for {service} or not ({on}): its <Service>Disabled property.

name: goa.signIn
doc: Sign in to the online account {id} again: EnsureCredentials, else GOA's sign-in dialog (win11-gtk-settings --goa-refresh).

name: machine.info
doc: What GNOME's About and System Details show beyond system.info: {hostname, staticHostname, prettyHostname, chassis, hardwareVendor, hardwareModel, model, firmwareVersion, osName, osShortName, osVersion, osBuild, osBits, architecture, gnomeVersion (GNOME Shell's ShellVersion), windowingSystem, virtualization, kernel, gpus, diskCapacity, disks: [{model, size}] (the drives diskCapacity sums), canRename}.

name: machine.languages
doc: The languages of language-selector's languagelist: {languages: [{code, name, endonym, locale, installed, complete, missing}], installing, canInstall}.

name: machine.languages.install
doc: Install the language support of {code} (pkg_depends' packages through PackageKit Resolve + InstallPackages); answers {started, packages} at once, then machine.changed {what: languages, code, percent} and {.., done: true, ok, error?}.

name: machine.locales
doc: The generated locales (localedef --list-archive, else the locale archive): {locales: [{id, name, endonym, language, country, supported}], session: {language, formats}}; with {preview: locale} also preview: {date, time, dateTime, number, measurement, paper, paperSize} (GNOME's Formats preview), null when that locale is not generated.

name: machine.login.get
doc: The sign-in screen's locale (locale1 Locale): {available, language (LANG), formats (LC_TIME), entries}.

name: machine.login.setLocale
doc: The sign-in screen's language and formats {locale?, formats?} (locale1 SetLocale with LANG and, for formats, LC_TIME, LC_NUMERIC, LC_MONETARY, LC_MEASUREMENT, LC_PAPER, as GNOME sends them; formats '' follows the language).

name: machine.setName
doc: Rename this PC: {name} as hostname1's PrettyHostname and its ASCII form (GNOME's derivation) as the static hostname; answers {prettyHostname, staticHostname}.

name: machine.time.get
doc: The system clock (timedate1): {available, timezone, zoneLabel, ntp, canNtp, synced, localRtc, server (chrony's or timesyncd's configured server, or null), lastSync (ms, when this host saw NTPSynchronized turn true), now}; event machine.changed {what: time}.

name: machine.time.setNtp
doc: Set time automatically {on} (timedate1 SetNTP).

name: machine.time.setTime
doc: Set the date and time manually {usec} (microseconds since the epoch, UTC; timedate1 SetTime), only while NTP is off.

name: machine.time.setTimezone
doc: The time zone {zone} (an IANA id; timedate1 SetTimezone).

name: machine.time.sync
doc: Sync now: timedate1 SetNTP(false) then SetNTP(true), which restarts the NTP service (no timesync1); only while NTP is on.

name: machine.time.zones
doc: The time zones of zone1970.tab and UTC, sorted by standard offset: {zones: [{id, label ('(UTC+01:00) Amsterdam'), offset (minutes)}]}.

name: users.changePassword
doc: Change the own password {current, new} through passwd and PAM, as GNOME Settings does.

name: users.create
doc: Add a user {realName, userName, accountType: standard|administrator, password?} (CreateUser; without a password the user sets one at the first sign-in).

name: users.delete
doc: Remove the user {uid} and, with {removeFiles: true}, the home folder (DeleteUser); never the own account, and not a user who is still logged in (logind, as GNOME Settings: denied users.loggedIn).

name: users.faces
doc: GNOME's stock account pictures: {faces: [{path, name}]}.

name: users.fingerprint.cancel
doc: Stop a running fingerprint enrolment and release the reader.

name: users.fingerprint.delete
doc: Delete the own enrolled fingerprints (fprintd DeleteEnrolledFingers2).

name: users.fingerprint.enroll
doc: Enrol {finger?} (fprintd's finger names, right-index-finger by default) for the own account; events users.fingerprint.progress {stage, stages, done, result}.

name: users.fingerprint.get
doc: The fingerprint reader and the own enrolled fingers: {available, device: {name, scanType, stages}, enrolled}.

name: users.list
doc: The people with an account on this PC (no system accounts), the own one first: {users, self, administrators}; each user as users.self, with loggedIn (logind); event users.changed.

name: users.passwordQuality
doc: libpwquality's verdict on {password, old?, userName?}: {level 0-5, strength, ok, hint}; with {generate: true} a generated {password}.

name: users.self
doc: The own account (AccountsService, else the password database with available: false): uid, userName, realName, iconFile, accountType, automaticLogin, language and formatsLocale (generated locale ids as machine.locales lists them; Ubuntu's stored values in languageRaw and formatsLocaleRaw; no language: the session's), loggedIn.

name: users.setAccountType
doc: Make the user {uid} an administrator or a standard user ({type}); one administrator stays.

name: users.setAutoLogin
doc: Sign the user {uid?} in automatically at start-up or not ({on}).

name: users.setFormats
doc: The regional format of {uid?}: {locale} as AccountsService's FormatsLocale (or empty for the language's); it applies at the next sign-in.

name: users.setIcon
doc: The account picture of {uid?}: {path} of a stock picture or a file (scaled to 512 px first), or an empty path to remove it.

name: users.setLanguage
doc: The display language of {uid?}: {language} as a locale (nl_NL.UTF-8) or empty for the system's; it applies at the next sign-in.

name: users.setPassword
doc: Reset the password of the user {uid}: {mode: now, password} or {mode: atLogin} (the user chooses one at the next sign-in).

name: users.setRealName
doc: The full name {name} of {uid?} (the own account without uid).
